item.title: Buying a phone in 2026? Follow this one rule
item.description: After a relatively quiet start for phone launches, 2026 is really about to ramp up. Then MWC 2026 is just days after that, where we’ll see countless more mobiles unveiled. They’ll all be vying for your attention; however, I have a growing sense that you might want to avoid them all. item.description: The news that Emerald Fennell, director of Promising Young Woman and Saltburn, was to adapt Wuthering Heights was initially met with enthusiasm. item.title: Android 17 beta announcement hints at final release date
item.description: While we wait for the March Pixel Drop, which is poised to be a big one, Google has confirmed news about Android 17 – codenamed Cinnamon Bun. item.title: The Baldur’s Gate TV series is heading to HBO Max
item.description: The craze for computer game adaptations is picking up steam. While Netflix is working on Assassin’s Creed and Amazon is gathering its cast for God of War, HBO is diving into the fantasy world of Baldur’s Gate 3. The award-winning game, created by Larian Studios, is set in a diverse Dungeons & Dragons universe. item.title: Baroque Works villains swing into action in One Piece season 2 first trailer
